clues.text: As Saul drew near this city on his journey, a light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
In this city, the Lord sent the disciple Ananias to a house on Straight Street to find Saul of Tarsus.
Isaiah declared that this city would no longer be a city but would become a heap of ruins.
After defeating Hadadezer, King David placed garrisons in the Aram of this city, and its Arameans brought him tribute.
King Ahaz saw an altar in this city and sent Uriah the priest a model and plans to copy it.
Childless Abram told the LORD that the heir of his house was Eliezer, a man from this city.
The prophet Elisha came to this city while Ben-hadad, king of Aram, was sick.
